rules: All records use Odoo website.rewrite with redirect_type=301.
Do not activate a 301 while an old website.page still owns the same URL; first remove the old route collision by changing/unpublishing the obsolete page.
Phase 2 redirects are applied only after the target page exists and its live content has been backed up/recomposed.
Keep language routing native to Odoo; do not create separate /pt, /es or /fr redirect rows unless live verification proves they are necessary.
Never redirect canonical learning routes /slides, /roadmaps or /unidades-curriculares away from their native owners.
